gate_rule: Assign timing to individual obligations, not broad headings. Later capabilities receive their own before-implementation gate when scheduled.

eight_refinements.qualification: Use per-obligation stages plus actual-data/effect activation trigger; not one stage per broad heading.
Write/review tests before code; deepest assertions may be blocked. No schema-to-auth admission and no fake implementations or discovery-only wrappers.
Capability-family architecture preservation now; exhaustive later specs/leaf acceptance deferred. Additive versus migration versus unknown is explicit.
Policy administration/delegation authority is already substantially specified; prove selected owners enforce it.
Migration/lifecycle designs already exist; require their tests and activation safeguards, not a new blank design exercise.
Invariant correctness never relaxes under overload; only measured budgets have operating envelopes. Employee count alone does not select technology.
Observable task hypotheses now; representative-user evidence before acceptance of exposed journeys. SSR tests are not usability.
Independently review and mutate fixtures/oracles/fault witnesses/history accounting; retain initial flawed checks as evidence, not accepted proof.
